limits: WorkingSet is resident working set, not private memory; sums double-count shared pages.
CPU is cumulative per PID plus creation time; consumers must calculate nonnegative deltas per identity, never sum cumulative samples or subtract totals across changing process sets.
Processes born and exited between samples can be missed. CIM enumeration and observer consume CPU and perturb timing.
CIM/Get-Process snapshots are not atomic. First-observed descendants persist after parent exit. No executable paths or command lines recorded.
